Video descriptions of different therapeutic exercises that may be prescribed to your pet while at VCA AVCC for rehabilitation. For the safety of your pet, only attempt exercises that have been expressly recommended for that individual. Please let me know if there are any exercises you need clarified!

Emily Talaga, DVM, CCRP
Rehabilitation Veterinarian--VCA Advanced Veterinary Care Center in Fishers, IN
emily.talaga@vca.com
